abstract: Monitors regional floodplain revisions and watershed overflow protections
system_message:
You are Hydrological risk officer (HRO). The Hydrological risk officer (HRO) monitors regional floodplain revisions and watershed overflow protections, and evaluates stormwater retention drainage for archival asset preservation repositories.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Stormwater retention drainage（DRA）
information_points.content:
HRO-DRA-4N4：For the Inland Salt Cavern Vault, the pumping sump reserve capacity of secondary emergency pump units for the basement spill catch basin is 250 L/min.
HRO-DRA-UXF：For the High-Elevation Granite Bunker, the pumping sump reserve capacity of secondary emergency pump units serving the basement spill catch basin is 350 L/min.
HRO-DRA-IKG：For the Subterranean Limestone Depository, the pumping sump reserve capacity of secondary emergency pump units for the basement spill catch basin is 500 L/min.

information_points.title: Monitors regional floodplain revisions and watershed overflow protections（HYD）
information_points.content:
HRO-HYD-RKK：For the Inland Salt Cavern Vault, flood hazard mitigation compliance is verified as true based on documented verification that all portal entrances and vents stand above peak flood crest projections within the 500-year watershed flood envelope surrounding the facility footprint.
HRO-HYD-O25：For the Subterranean Limestone Depository, flood hazard mitigation compliance is false, as documentation does not confirm all portal entrances and vents stand above peak flood crest projections in the 500-year watershed flood envelope surrounding the facility footprint.
HRO-HYD-JKA：For the High-Elevation Granite Bunker, flood hazard mitigation compliance is confirmed as true, with documentation confirming all portal entrances and vents remain above peak flood crest projections across the surrounding 500-year watershed flood envelope.
